methodology: Verse-level thematic screening; candidate locators are research leads only, NOT primary-text-checked, verified or approved for publication. Do not infer literary dependence from thematic resemblance. Composition dating and manuscript witnesses require separate review.

records.topic: God as protector of the righteous

candidates.difference: Psalm invokes refuge and shelter; Qur'an 7:196 names God as the revealer of the Book and protector of the righteous.

records.question: Check Hebrew Psalm text, verse numbering, and whether a more specific pre-Islamic witness exists.

records.topic: Invoked beings unable to help themselves or worshippers

candidates.difference: Psalm focuses on sensory and bodily incapacity of manufactured idols; Qur'an 7:197 states the broader inability to aid or protect.
Isaiah's carried idol cannot answer or save; Qur'an's rhetoric addresses those invoked besides God.

records.topic: Invoked beings cannot hear or perceive

candidates.difference: Psalm describes idols with mouths, eyes, and ears; Qur'an 7:198 speaks of inability to hear guidance and seeing without perceiving.
